question: Did lululemon's second-quarter fiscal 2026 (quarter ended August 2, 2026) net revenue and diluted EPS land above, within or below the Q2 guidance ranges the company gave in its first-quarter release in June 2026?
grading: Key points: (1) revenue USD 2,415.6M vs guidance USD 2,450M-2,475M = BELOW the range; (2) diluted EPS USD 2.92 vs guidance USD 1.76-1.81 = ABOVE the range; (3) notes the guidance did not include IEEPA tariff refunds and that Q2 EPS included USD 0.86/share from refunds and interest, so EPS excluding that (~USD 2.06) is still above the top of the range; (4) benchmark is company guidance, not consensus. Fail if both are called beats or if consensus is used.
answer: Against the Q2 guidance in the June 4, 2026 release (net revenue USD 2.450-2.475 billion; diluted EPS USD 1.76-1.81; guidance excluded any IEEPA tariff refunds) [T11-E1], Q2 FY2026 net revenue was USD 2,415.6 million (below the low end by about 1.4%) and diluted EPS was USD 2.92 (above the high end). The EPS includes USD 0.86 per share from IEEPA tariff refunds ($134.5M) and associated interest ($4.1M); excluding that, EPS is about USD 2.06, still above the USD 1.81 top of the range. [T11-E2]

output.answer:
**Short answer: Split — revenue came in *below* the Q2 guidance range, while diluted EPS came in *above* it.**

**Guidance given June 4, 2026 (Q1 FY2026 release):**
- Q2 net revenue: **$2.450B–$2.475B** (a decline of ~2–3%)
- Q2 diluted EPS: **$1.76–$1.81**

**Actual Q2 FY2026 results (quarter ended Aug 2, 2026; reported Sep 3, 2026):**
- Net revenue: **$2.416B**, down 4% (5% constant dollar) → **below the range** (short of the low end by ~$34M). Revenue also missed the ~$2.46B analyst consensus.
- Diluted EPS: **$2.92** → **above the range** (by ~$1.11 at the midpoint). Note that this includes a **$0.86/share benefit** from IEEPA tariff refunds ($134.5M refunds + $4.1M interest, net of tax). Even excluding that one-time item, EPS was roughly **$2.06**, still well above the $1.76–$1.81 guidance.

The company simultaneously slashed full-year FY2026 guidance to revenue of $10.35B–$10.50B (down 5–7%) and EPS of $9.48–$9.73, down from the prior $11.0B–$11.15B and $10.95–$11.15 — and guided Q3 revenue to $2.29B–$2.32B (down 10–11%) with EPS of $0.93–$0.98.

Sources:
- [lululemon Q2 FY2026 results (Sep 3, 2026)](https://corporate.lululemon.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/09-03-2026-210528733)
- [lululemon Q1 FY2026 results / Q2 guidance (Jun 4, 2026)](https://corporate.lululemon.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/06-04-2026-210523775)
- [Q2 2026 financial supplement (PDF)](https://corporate.lululemon.com/~/media/Files/L/Lululemon/investors/results-center/q2-2026-financial-supplement.pdf)
- [Q2 FY2026 10-Q (SEC)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1397187/000139718726000127/lulu-20260802.htm)
- [CNBC Q1 2026 coverage](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/04/lululemon-lulu-earnings-q1-2026.html)
